Hi Alyssa — Rachel here (Solutions). Thanks for filling out the intake form — appreciate the thoroughness. Jan 12, 9:30–10:15 AM PT is good for our SE and security lead. I've included a short pre-demo checklist below and attached our SOC2 summary and a high-level private deployment diagram.

Pre-demo checklist (helps us tailor the demo):
- Who will own networking (customer-managed VPC or on-prem network team)? Please provide an admin contact.
- Do you require HSM/KMS integration (Y/N) and which provider (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, on-prem HSM)?
- Expected peak throughput (reqs/tokens/sec or requests/minute) and target p95 latency.
- Any egress/data residency constraints (specific regions or blocked destinations).
- A point of contact for SOC2 evidence requests and the email for your security reviewer.

We'll cover: architecture options (VPC peering, private link), key management, audit logging/auditor access patterns, and deployment timeline estimates.

Proposed meeting:
- Date: Tue, Jan 12, 2027
- Time: 9:30–10:15 AM PT
- Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example

Attachments: SOC2_overview.pdf (PDF - 220KB), redwood_private_arch_diagram.png (PNG - 180KB)

See you then — I'll send a calendar invite in a moment.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0199
